mainEntity.name: Is Amigo more undetectable than Final Round AI?

mainEntity.name: What is the Buddy feature that Final Round AI doesn't have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amigo's Buddy feature lets you invite a friend or mentor into your interview session via a shareable link. They can watch your interview in real time and send AI-assisted tips through the Amigo overlay — a unique two-layer support system no other tool offers.

mainEntity.name: Can I try Amigo for free before switching from Final Round AI?

The gaps

Why people look for an alternative

Final Round AI is a popular, broad interview-prep copilot — but a few gaps send users looking elsewhere.

Visible in System Monitors

Final Round AI is not hidden in Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS). Some interviewers check system process lists — and Final Round AI will show up there.

Higher Price

Final Round AI's subscription plans cost significantly more than Amigo's pay-as-you-go credits. You pay whether or not you're actively interviewing.

No Buddy Collaboration

Final Round AI has no way to bring a trusted friend or mentor into your interview session. You're on your own — there's no second layer of live human support.

The edge

How Amigo pulls ahead

6 places Amigo outperforms Final Round AI.

Buddy Feature

Live Human + AI Support

Invite a trusted friend or mentor via a shareable link. They watch your interview in real time and send AI-assisted tips through your Amigo overlay. No other tool offers this two-layer support system.

Deep Stealth Mode

100% Undetectable

Amigo is hidden from screen share, Dock, Taskbar, Task Manager, System Monitor, and Activity Monitor. Final Round AI is visible in system process lists — Amigo isn't.

Under 0.3s Response

Truly Real-Time

Amigo surfaces short, personalized, natural answers the moment your interviewer finishes speaking. No CTRL+ENTER required — just seamless, in-the-moment support.

Coding Interview Copilot

HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad

Amigo reads your screen during live coding challenges and provides hints, pseudocode, time complexity analysis, and working solutions in real time.

Natural STAR Answers

Scenario-Based, Not Robotic

Responses are tailored to your resume and the specific job description — structured in STAR format and adjusted to your preferred length (Concise, Balanced, or Detailed).

30% Lower Price

Pay-As-You-Go, No Subscription

Amigo uses credits — you only pay for the interviews you do. No monthly subscription, no lock-in. Starting at $15 for 2 hours, roughly 30% less than Final Round AI.
